In plain words What this file contains What calls what Items

Image EXIF/GPS removal.

Images are handled at the container level with img-parts: the EXIF and XMP segments are dropped and the compressed pixel data is copied through untouched. Nothing is re-encoded, so cleaning is lossless and cannot introduce visible artefacts.

GPS coordinates are the reason this matters most. A single holiday snapshot attached to an otherwise anonymous message can place someone within a few metres, and no amount of voice processing helps with that.

In plain words

Strips the hidden information out of a picture, including where it was taken.

Photographs from a phone routinely carry the exact location, the time, the device and its serial number. The picture is copied through untouched and only those sections are dropped, so nothing about how it looks changes.
